run_pipeline_ltx_i2v_long_multi_prompt: run the LTXI2VLongMultiPromptPipeline to generate long-duration image-to-video sequences with multi-prompt scheduling
build_temporal_windows: build sliding temporal windows from latent frames with configurable tile size and overlap for memory-efficient video generation
create_latent_coords: create latent patch top-left coordinates in (t, y, x) order scaled to pixel space for RoPE embedding alignment
run_vae_decode_tiled: run VAE-based spatial tiled decoding with linear feathering and blending to avoid seams and prevent out-of-memory errors
fuse_window_latents: fuse consecutive window latent outputs using linear crossfade overlap blending and AdaIN normalization for cross-window consistency
